N3.film_stream: book film_gap_loans assumptions: vol 22%, rho(HYG) 0.30, PD 8%, LGD 50%, coupon 20%. Return HEADLINE = 20% (contract rate, no loss); ADJUSTED = (1-PD) x coupon - PD x LGD = 14.4% (PD 8% sits above Fitch 6.3% TTM Aug-2026, which counts maturity extensions as defaults; Casey ledger ~1 late of ~12; LGD 50% junior-mezz judgement, math B7/B8, factcheck CORRECTED prints)
N3.venture_stream: book venture_basket method for 17.5 equal deals: vol = 90% x sqrt(0.30 + 0.70/17.5) = 52.5%; rho(IWM) 0.40; prior mu = rf + 0.30 x vol (neutral prior). Casey's '20-30%' shown alongside, not used
N3.spcx_stream: one-factor on QQQ: beta, total vol and idio vol measured on SPCX's listed window (daily, 2026-06-15..2026-09-30, ~75 obs); cov(SPCX, j) = beta x cov(QQQ, j); prior = zero-alpha rf + beta x (mu_QQQ - rf)
N3.private_cov: factor model: cov(p, j) = rho x sigma_p / sigma_f x cov(f, j), f = HYG (film) / IWM (venture) on the 3y window; var(p) = sigma_p^2
